//===== rAthena Script =======================================
//= World sync: Rune Tablet
//===== Description: =========================================
//= GENERATED by tools/world_sync/rune_tablet.py from the client's
//= Rune tables (System/Rune). Do not edit by hand: edit the
//= template tools/world_sync/rune_tablet.tmpl.txt instead.
//=
//= kRO's Rune Tablet window through NPC menus:
//=  Rune Book      register runes by handing in their materials
//=  Rune Tablet    sets of runes; bonuses by runes registered and
//=                 by upgrade level (+1..+15)
//=  Decomposition  break items down into rune materials
//= Character variables: RT_R_<rune> registered, RT_L_<set> level,
//= RT_F_<set> failure bonus, RT_W_<set> rewards given (bits),
//= RT_SET[]/RT_CNT[] sets with runes and how many.
//============================================================

prontera,140,190,4	script	Rune Tablet#ws	4_F_JOB_BLACKSMITH,{
	mes "[Rune Tablet]";
	mes "Register runes, build their sets and grow them stronger.";
	while (1) {
		switch (select("Rune Book (register runes):Rune Tablet (sets and upgrades):Decompose items:My active sets:Leave")) {
		case 1: callsub S_Book; break;
		case 2: callsub S_Tablet; break;
		case 3: callsub S_Decompose; break;
		case 4: callsub S_Mine; break;
		default: close;
		}
	}

S_PickTag:
	// getarg(0): 0 = runes, 1 = sets. Returns the tag, or -1.
	.@menu$ = "";
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.tag); .@i++) {
		.@n = 0;
		if (getarg(0) == 0) {
			for (.@j = 0; .@j < getarraysize(.r_id); .@j++)
				if (.r_tag[.@j] == .tag[.@i]) .@n++;
		} else {
			for (.@j = 0; .@j < getarraysize(.s_id); .@j++)
				if (.s_tag[.@j] == .tag[.@i]) .@n++;
		}
		.@menu$ += (.@n ? .tag_name$[.@i] + " (" + .@n + ")" : "") + ":";
	}
	.@pick = select(.@menu$ + "Back") - 1;
	return (.@pick >= getarraysize(.tag)) ? -1 : .tag[.@pick];

S_Mats:
	// getarg(0): "id,qty;id,qty". Lists them; returns 1 when the player has all.
	deletearray .@row$;
	explode(.@row$, getarg(0), ";");
	.@ok = 1;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@row$); .@i++) {
		deletearray .@f$;
		explode(.@f$, .@row$[.@i], ",");
		.@id = atoi(.@f$[0]);
		.@need = atoi(.@f$[1]);
		.@have = countitem(.@id);
		mes (.@have >= .@need ? "^008800" : "^CC0000") + getitemname(.@id) + " " + .@have + "/" + .@need + "^000000";
		if (.@have < .@need) .@ok = 0;
	}
	return .@ok;

S_Take:
	deletearray .@row$;
	explode(.@row$, getarg(0), ";");
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@row$); .@i++) {
		deletearray .@f$;
		explode(.@f$, .@row$[.@i], ",");
		delitem atoi(.@f$[0]), atoi(.@f$[1]);
	}
	return;

S_Book:
	.@tag = callsub(S_PickTag, 0);
	if (.@tag < 0) return;
	while (1) {
		next;
		mes "[Rune Book]";
		mes "Runes of " + .tag_name$[inarray(.tag, .@tag)] + ":";
		.@menu$ = "";
		.@k = 0;
		for (.@j = 0; .@j < getarraysize(.r_id); .@j++) {
			if (.r_tag[.@j] != .@tag) continue;
			.@idx[.@k] = .@j;
			.@menu$ += (getd("RT_R_" + .r_id[.@j]) ? "[Done] " : "") + .r_name$[.@j] + ":";
			.@k++;
		}
		.@pick = select(.@menu$ + "Back") - 1;
		if (.@pick >= .@k) return;
		.@j = .@idx[.@pick];
		next;
		mes "[Rune Book]";
		mes "^0000FF" + .r_name$[.@j] + "^000000";
		if (getd("RT_R_" + .r_id[.@j])) {
			mes "Already registered.";
			continue;
		}
		mes "To register it, hand in:";
		.@ok = callsub(S_Mats, .r_mat$[.@j]);
		if (!.@ok) {
			mes "You don't have everything yet.";
			continue;
		}
		if (select("Register it:Not now") == 2) continue;
		callsub S_Take, .r_mat$[.@j];
		setd "RT_R_" + .r_id[.@j], 1;
		callsub S_Recount;
		next;
		mes "[Rune Book]";
		mes "^0000FF" + .r_name$[.@j] + "^000000 is registered.";
	}

S_Recount:
	// Rebuild RT_SET/RT_CNT, hand out new rewards, refresh the bonus.
	deletearray RT_SET;
	deletearray RT_CNT;
	.@n = 0;
	for (.@s = 0; .@s < getarraysize(.s_id); .@s++) {
		deletearray .@slot$;
		explode(.@slot$, .s_slot$[.@s], ",");
		.@c = 0;
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@slot$); .@i++)
			if (getd("RT_R_" + .@slot$[.@i])) .@c++;
		if (!.@c) continue;
		RT_SET[.@n] = .s_id[.@s];
		RT_CNT[.@n] = .@c;
		.@n++;
		// rewards: [0] activation, [k-1] at k runes (k = 2..6), [6] completion
		deletearray .@rw$;
		explode(.@rw$, .s_rw$[.@s], ",");
		.@given = getd("RT_W_" + .s_id[.@s]);
		for (.@k = 0; .@k < 7; .@k++) {
			.@item = atoi(.@rw$[.@k]);
			if (!.@item || (.@given & (1 << .@k))) continue;
			if (.@k == 0) .@due = 1;
			else if (.@k == 6) .@due = getarraysize(.@slot$);
			else .@due = .@k + 1;
			if (.@c < .@due) continue;
			getitem .@item, 1;
			.@given |= 1 << .@k;
			dispbottom "Rune Tablet: " + .s_name$[.@s] + " reward: " + getitemname(.@item) + ".";
		}
		setd "RT_W_" + .s_id[.@s], .@given;
	}
	callsub S_Apply;
	return;

S_Apply:
	if (getarraysize(RT_SET))
		bonus_script "{ callfunc \"F_RuneTabletBonus\"; }", 999999999, 512|1024;
	recalculatestat;
	return;

S_Tablet:
	.@tag = callsub(S_PickTag, 1);
	if (.@tag < 0) return;
	while (1) {
		next;
		mes "[Rune Tablet]";
		mes "Sets of " + .tag_name$[inarray(.tag, .@tag)] + ":";
		.@menu$ = "";
		.@k = 0;
		for (.@s = 0; .@s < getarraysize(.s_id); .@s++) {
			if (.s_tag[.@s] != .@tag) continue;
			.@idx[.@k] = .@s;
			deletearray .@slot$;
			explode(.@slot$, .s_slot$[.@s], ",");
			.@c = 0;
			for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@slot$); .@i++)
				if (getd("RT_R_" + .@slot$[.@i])) .@c++;
			.@lv = getd("RT_L_" + .s_id[.@s]);
			.@menu$ += .s_name$[.@s] + " " + .@c + "/" + getarraysize(.@slot$) + (.@lv ? " +" + .@lv : "") + ":";
			.@k++;
		}
		.@pick = select(.@menu$ + "Back") - 1;
		if (.@pick >= .@k) return;
		callsub S_Set, .@idx[.@pick];
	}

S_Set:
	.@s = getarg(0);
	while (1) {
		next;
		deletearray .@slot$;
		explode(.@slot$, .s_slot$[.@s], ",");
		.@c = 0;
		mes "[" + .s_name$[.@s] + "]";
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@slot$); .@i++) {
			.@r = inarray(.r_id, atoi(.@slot$[.@i]));
			.@on = getd("RT_R_" + .@slot$[.@i]);
			if (.@on) .@c++;
			mes (.@on ? "^008800" : "^999999") + .r_name$[.@r] + "^000000";
		}
		.@lv = getd("RT_L_" + .s_id[.@s]);
		mes "Upgrade level: +" + .@lv;
		deletearray .@d$;
		explode(.@d$, .s_desc$[.@s], "|");
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@d$); .@i++)
			mes .@d$[.@i];
		if (select((.@lv < 15 ? "Upgrade to +" + (.@lv + 1) : "") + ":Back") == 2) return;
		if (!.@c) {
			next;
			mes "[" + .s_name$[.@s] + "]";
			mes "Register at least one of its runes first.";
			continue;
		}
		deletearray .@up$;
		explode(.@up$, .s_up$[.@s], "|");
		deletearray .@rate$;
		explode(.@rate$, .s_rate$[.@s], ",");
		deletearray .@fail$;
		explode(.@fail$, .s_fail$[.@s], ",");
		.@chance = atoi(.@rate$[.@lv]) + getd("RT_F_" + .s_id[.@s]);
		if (.@chance > 100000) .@chance = 100000;
		next;
		mes "[" + .s_name$[.@s] + "] +" + .@lv + " -> +" + (.@lv + 1);
		mes "Success chance: " + (.@chance / 1000) + "." + ((.@chance % 1000) / 100) + "%";
		.@ok = callsub(S_Mats, .@up$[.@lv]);
		if (!.@ok) {
			mes "You don't have everything yet.";
			continue;
		}
		if (select("Upgrade:Not now") == 2) continue;
		callsub S_Take, .@up$[.@lv];
		next;
		mes "[" + .s_name$[.@s] + "]";
		if (rand(100000) < .@chance) {
			setd "RT_L_" + .s_id[.@s], .@lv + 1;
			setd "RT_F_" + .s_id[.@s], 0;
			specialeffect2 EF_REFINEOK;
			mes "Success! It is now +" + (.@lv + 1) + ".";
			callsub S_Apply;
		} else {
			setd "RT_F_" + .s_id[.@s], getd("RT_F_" + .s_id[.@s]) + atoi(.@fail$[.@lv]);
			specialeffect2 EF_REFINEFAIL;
			mes "It failed. The next attempt is a little more likely to succeed.";
		}
	}

S_Decompose:
	getinventorylist;
	.@menu$ = "";
	.@k = 0;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < @inventorylist_count; .@i++) {
		.@d = inarray(.d_id, @inventorylist_id[.@i]);
		if (.@d < 0 || @inventorylist_equip[.@i]) continue;
		if (inarray(.@seen, @inventorylist_id[.@i]) >= 0) continue;
		.@seen[.@k] = @inventorylist_id[.@i];
		.@idx[.@k] = .@d;
		.@menu$ += getitemname(@inventorylist_id[.@i]) + " x" + countitem(@inventorylist_id[.@i]) + ":";
		.@k++;
	}
	next;
	mes "[Decomposition]";
	if (!.@k) {
		mes "Nothing you carry can be decomposed.";
		return;
	}
	mes "What should I break down?";
	.@pick = select(.@menu$ + "Back") - 1;
	if (.@pick >= .@k) return;
	.@d = .@idx[.@pick];
	.@id = .d_id[.@d];
	.@opt$ = "One:" + (countitem(.@id) >= .many && .d_many$[.@d] != "" ? .many + " at once" : "");
	.@how = select(.@opt$ + ":Cancel");
	if (.@how == 3) return;
	.@rows$ = (.@how == 2) ? .d_many$[.@d] : .d_one$[.@d];
	if (.@rows$ == "") .@rows$ = .d_one$[.@d];
	delitem .@id, (.@how == 2 ? .many : 1);
	deletearray .@row$;
	explode(.@row$, .@rows$, "|");
	.@got = 0;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@row$); .@i++) {
		deletearray .@f$;
		explode(.@f$, .@row$[.@i], ",");
		if (rand(100000) >= atoi(.@f$[3])) continue;
		.@q = rand(atoi(.@f$[1]), atoi(.@f$[2]));
		getitem atoi(.@f$[0]), .@q;
		mes "Got " + getitemname(atoi(.@f$[0])) + " x" + .@q + ".";
		.@got++;
	}
	if (!.@got) mes "Nothing usable came out of it.";
	return;

S_Mine:
	next;
	mes "[Rune Tablet]";
	if (!getarraysize(RT_SET)) {
		mes "No set has a registered rune yet.";
		return;
	}
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(RT_SET); .@i++) {
		.@s = inarray(.s_id, RT_SET[.@i]);
		mes .s_name$[.@s] + ": " + RT_CNT[.@i] + " rune(s), +" + getd("RT_L_" + RT_SET[.@i]);
	}
	return;

OnPCLoginEvent:
	if (getarraysize(RT_SET))
		bonus_script "{ callfunc \"F_RuneTabletBonus\"; }", 999999999, 512|1024;
	end;

OnInit:
	setarray .r_id[0],1263000,1263001,1263002,1263003,1263004,1263005,1263006,1263007,1263008,1263009,1263010,1263011,1263012,1263013,1263014,1263015,1263016,1263017,1263018,1263019,1263020,1263021,1263022,1263023,1263024,1263025,1263026,1263027,1263028,1263029,1263030,1263035,1263036,1263037,1263038,1263039,1263040,1263041,1263042,1263043,1263044,1263045,1263046,1263047,1263048,1263049,1263050,1263051,1263052,1263053,1263054,1263055,1263056,1263057,1263058,1263059,1263060,1263061,1263062,1263063,1263064,1263065,1263066,1263067,1263068,1263069,1263070,1263080,1263081,1263082,1263083,1263084,1263085,1263086,1263087,1263088,1263089,1263090,1263091,1263092,1263106,1263107,1263108,1263109,1263110,1263111,1263112,1263113,1263114,1263115,1263116,1263117,1263118,1263119,1263120,1263093,1263094,1263095,1263096,1263097;
	setarray .r_id[100],1263098,1263099,1263100,1263101,1263102,1263103,1263104,1263105,1263126,1263127,1263128,1263129,1263130,1263131,1263132,1263133,1263134,1263135,1263136,1263137,1263138,1263031,1263032,1263033,1263034,1263072,1263073,1263074,1263075,1263076,1263077,1263078,1263079;
	setarray .r_tag[0],17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,18,19,19,19,19,19,19,19,19,19,19,19,19,19,19,19,19,19,20,20,20,20,20,20,20,20,20,20,20,20,20,21,21,21,21,21,21,21,21,21,21,21,21,21,21,21,22,22,22,22,22;
	setarray .r_tag[100],22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,22,500,500,500,500,500,500,500,500,500,500,500,500;
	setarray .r_name$[0],"Doubtful Components(Melee)","Doubtful Components(Ranged)","Doubtful Components(Magic)","Doubtful Components(Hidden Weapon)","Automatic Armor A","Automatic Armor B","Heart Hunter Bellare","Heart Hunter Sanare","Plaga","Bestia","Venenum","Dolor","Iron Scrap","Hot Red Pepper","Spell Addict","Spell Sphere","Spell Overload","Baths Administration","Papila Triplets","Bookworm","Garden Administrator","Sewage All Star","Allergy Warning","Hot (Spicy) Soup","Drowsy Pitaya Partya","Garden Beautification","Aries","Broken Robot","Sweetie","Meow","Tiger Strength","Gray Wolf Armor A","Gray Wolf Armor B","Adulter Fides Blades","Adulter Fides Heavy Weapon","Adulter Fides Ranger","Adulter Fides Book","Adulter Fides Magical","Adulter Fides Cutter","Adulter Fides Gun","Adulter Fides Fist","Adulter Fides Rhythm","Rakehand","Ashring Recipe","Phantom Kite","Grey Wolf","Lava and Ash","Hot Volcaring","Burning Fang","Demigod","Snow Flower Armor A","Snow Flower Armor B","Glacier Blade","Glacier Crasher","Glacier Cleaver","Glacier Piercer","Glacier Caster","Glacier Marksman","Limacina","Fusion","Snow Flower","Frozen Lake","Watcher","Family","Failure","Infiltration","Renovation","Glacier Armor A","Glacier Armor B","Glacier Guard","Cold Daily Life","Nest","Snail","Rookie Recruiting","Hide and Seek","Mess","Heal","Jormun Squadron","Sweeper","Ultimate","Gaebolg A","Gaebolg B","Ice Sea Seafood","Ice Sea Seawater","Fluffy Soft","Yorker","Yoster Squadron","Yormi Duo","Yordos Trio","Yoscopus","Bishop","Ice Horn","Arbiter","Ghost Captain","Tan","Entwined Armor A","Entwined Armor B","Warrior's Footsteps","Hunter's Footsteps","Wise One's Footsteps";
	setarray .r_name$[100],"Sorcerer's Footsteps","Executioner's Footsteps","Dimensional Frontier Stone","Dimensional Energy","Dimensional Essence","Fragment of Chaos","Rune of Chaos","Essence of Chaos","Rolling","Volcano","Yggleaf","Noise","Flowers Bouquet","Junk Disposal Squad","Toxic Gathering","Knightage","Creepy Flowers","Polluted","Uncanny Legion","Bulgasari","Glutto","Night Market Poring","Night Market Lunatic","Night Market Fabre","Night Market Food","Night Market Bebe","Night Market Coco","Rocker Playing","Passionate Vocal","Fixation Roda Frog","All Sightseeing Ambernite","Humming Hornet","Happy Stainer";

// The rune set bonuses, run by the character's permanent bonus_script.
function	script	F_RuneTabletBonus	{
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(RT_SET); .@i++) {
		.@c = RT_CNT[.@i];
		.@lv = getd("RT_L_" + RT_SET[.@i]);
		switch (RT_SET[.@i]) {
	case 1260000:
		if (.@c >= 2) {
			bonus bBaseAtk,2*(.@lv/3);
			bonus bMatk,2*(.@lv/3);
		}
		if (.@c >= 4) {
			bonus2 bAddSize,Size_All,1;
			bonus bBaseAtk,10;
			bonus bMatk,10;
		}
		break;
	case 1260001:
		if (.@c >= 2) {
			bonus bDef,100;
			bonus bMdef,25;
			bonus bMaxHPrate,1*(.@lv/3);
		}
		break;
	case 1260002:
		if (.@c >= 2) {
			bonus2 bAddEle,Ele_Poison,2*(.@lv/3);
		}
		if (.@c >= 3) {
			bonus bAspdRate,4;
		}
		break;
	case 1260003:
		if (.@c >= 2) {
			bonus bVariableCastrate,-1*(.@lv/3);
		}
		if (.@c >= 3) {
			bonus2 bMagicAtkEle,Ele_Neutral,3;
		}
		break;
	case 1260004:
		if (.@c >= 2) {
			bonus bCritAtkRate,3;
			bonus bCritAtkRate,2*(.@lv/5);
		}
		if (.@c >= 3) {
			bonus bCritAtkRate,8;
		}
		break;
	case 1260005:
		if (.@c >= 2) {
			bonus bMatk,15;
			bonus bMatk,3*(.@lv/5);
		}
		if (.@c >= 3) {
			bonus2 bMagicAtkEle,Ele_All,1;
		}
		if (.@c >= 4) {
			bonus2 bMagicAtkEle,Ele_All,4;
		}
		break;
	case 1260006:
		if (.@c >= 2) {
			bonus2 bAddRace,RC_Brute,1*(.@lv/5);
			bonus2 bAddRace,RC_Fish,1*(.@lv/5);

		break;
	case 1260007:

			bonus2 bAddRace,RC_Plant,1*(.@lv/5);

		if (.@c >= 4) {

		}
		break;
	case 1260008:
		if (.@c >= 2) {
			bonus2 bAddRace,RC_Formless,1*(.@lv/5);
			bonus2 bAddRace,RC_DemiHuman,1*(.@lv/5);
		}
		if (.@c >= 3) {

		}

			bonus bMatkRate,7;
		}
		break;
	case 1260009:

		}

		break;
	case 1260010:

		}
